## History

Following Matthew's sudden death from heart failure, Martin and other household members gather with community neighbors to mourn the loss. He witnesses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) attempting to comfort each other through their profound grief during the immediate aftermath of the tragedy.

## Relationships

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--martin.md)

Martin works for [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as a hired hand at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where his duties include driving for her. He provides labor and transportation for the household during the events of the story.

- Serves under — drives for her and works at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028)</sub>
